scope: Direct official app-server baseline; not Code Atlas adapter acceptance

result.title: Synthetic cart total calculations
result.summary: The module sums validated prices for the subtotal, then applies a validated tax rate to that subtotal.

functions.name: subtotal
functions.explanation: Rejects any price that is non-finite or negative with a RangeError. Otherwise, sums all prices, starting from zero.

functions.name: totalWithTax
functions.explanation: Rejects a non-finite or negative tax rate with a RangeError. If valid, calls subtotal(prices) and multiplies the result by 1 + taxRate.
